title: Ohio Man’s Reckless Attempt to Outrun Police Ends Very Badly
description:
Ohio police confront a man driving an alleged stolen vehicle in a Euclid gas station parking lot in October 2023 when things go from 0 to 100 in just seconds. Corrione Lawrence then learned a hard lesson about why you shouldn’t try to outrun cops. He faces numerous charges in connection to his reckless attempt to flee from police.
